description.value: Pizza Factory Tsawwassen is a locally operated pizza and fast-food restaurant on 56 Street in Tsawwassen, steps from the South Delta waterfront cycling corridor. The menu spans gourmet specialty pizzas, chicken wings, pasta, and salads, with in-house delivery drivers and an online ordering option. It sits in a community-oriented strip serving a neighbourhood near the Tsawwassen Ferry terminal and Boundary Bay cycling routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content fully corroborates OSM phone (604.943.5600) and address (1342 – 56st. Tsawwassen). The site confirms this is a takeout and delivery operation ('Delivered by our in-house drivers', 'Order Now'). No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenity, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: Washrooms not mentioned on website — unclear if accessible to walk-in/takeout customers; particularly relevant as this is a takeout-oriented operation.
No bike parking information available from website or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Business is a legitimate food stop in a cycling-friendly area, but none of the core WWC cyclist criteria (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or outreach to the business is needed before listing.

wow_evidence: locally operated pizza and fast-food restaurant
